best_narrative.body: Hims operates across multiple telehealth categories with material exposure to state asynchronous prescribing rules and compounded GLP-1 supply chain dependencies that peers are now actively defending at the federal level. Four direct competitors in the GLP-1 weight-loss telehealth segment filed federal lobbying disclosures on telehealth topics within the past month, signaling coordinated government affairs mobilization.
